title: Timed (15 min): full class
prompt: Set **15 minutes**. Implement the `Timer` class: constructor takes the start value (> 0 expected). `tick(n)` counts down by n but **never below 0**. `reset()` returns the timer to its constructor value. `expired()` is true when the value is 0. `value()` reports the current count.

tests.name: timer class
tests.hint: Store the constructor value; tick clamps at 0; reset restores it; expired reads the value.
